login.title: Platform admin
login.intro: Sign in with your username and password.

errors.unauthorized: The session ended. Sign in again.
errors.invalidLogin: The username or password is incorrect.
errors.invalidReason: Enter a reason of up to 200 characters, then confirm.
errors.invalidLanguage: Choose Arabic or English, then try again.
errors.invalidOrder: The catalog order changed. Reload the page and arrange it again.
errors.notFound: That record is no longer available. Return to the list.
errors.catalogUnresolved: That channel reference could not be resolved. Use a channel id, @username, or t.me link.
errors.catalogNotChannel: That chat is not a channel.
errors.catalogUnavailable: Telegram could not be checked. Try again.
errors.catalogNotAdmin: The platform bot must be an administrator of the channel before it can be activated.
errors.catalogJoinUnavailable: Activation needs a join link. Make the channel public or let the platform bot create an invite.
errors.invalidBroadcast: Write the post, choose at least one bot scope, and select bots when the campaign is limited.
errors.generic: The request could not be completed. Try again.

common.emptyFiltered: Nothing matches. Change the search or clear a filter.

overview.title: Overview
overview.purpose: Current platform figures, then a direct path into management.
overview.cyclesActive: {count, plural, one {# publish cycle is still active.} other {# publish cycles are still active.}}
overview.cyclesNone: There are no active publish cycles.
overview.catalogCount: {count, plural, one {# channel is in the platform catalog.} other {# channels are in the platform catalog.}}

users.purpose: Telegram accounts known to the platform.
users.title: Users
users.name: Name

bots.title: Bots
bots.purpose: Every bot connected to the platform. Starting or deleting a bot is not available here.
bots.linksHint: Each row is this bot’s link to a channel, not the channel record itself.
bots.supportHint: List settings only. Memberships and publish cycles stay on the support-list page.

channels.title: Channels
channels.name: Channel
channels.purpose: Each channel is one record, even when several bots link to it.
channels.recordHint: This unique channel: its title, status, and who added it.
channels.linksHint: Bots linked to this channel. Stopping a link does not delete the channel.

publishing.title: Publishing
publishing.reasonHint: The channel owner sees this text as written.
publishing.purpose: Support lists and scheduled publishing, separate from the unique channel record.
publishing.disableResult: This stops publishing for this channel in this list only. The record is not deleted.

catalog.title: Forced subscription
catalog.purpose: Active catalog channels are required on every bot. Add, arrange, and activate them here. Owner subscriptions stay read-only.
catalog.catalogHint: Activation checks that the platform bot is an administrator and that a join link is available. The channel is not copied into bot subscriptions.
catalog.subsHint: Forced subscriptions already stored by owners. This list does not edit them and does not enforce them.
catalog.confirmActivate: This channel becomes active in the platform catalog after the platform bot is confirmed as an administrator. It is not copied into bot subscriptions.
catalog.confirmDeactivate: This channel becomes inactive in the platform catalog. Existing owner subscriptions stay as they are.
catalog.referenceHint: Channel id, @username, or a t.me link. The row is added inactive.
catalog.confirmRemove: This removes the channel from the platform catalog. The channel record stays, and owner subscriptions are not changed.

audit.purpose: What an admin changed from the dashboard: language, catalog, and support-list membership.
audit.title: Audit log

broadcastReason.deleted: Channel is deleted for this scope
broadcastReason.bot_out_of_scope: No selected bot matches the scope

broadcast.title: Broadcast
broadcast.purpose: Write one post, preview who can receive it, then send in the background. A channel linked to several bots receives one copy.
broadcast.confirmHint: Sending does not turn bots, channels, or links back on.
broadcast.confirmStop: Remaining sends stop. Messages already handed to Telegram stay as recorded.
broadcast.noEligible: No channel can receive this post.
